about.heading: Bibli — build information
book.confirm_add_copy:
Please confirm adding a copy of “*{0}*”.
A new code will be created, to print and stick on the book.
book.confirm_delete.one:
Please confirm deleting “*{1}*” and its copy.
This cannot be undone.
book.confirm_delete.other:
Please confirm deleting “*{1}*” and its {0} copies.
This cannot be undone.
book.delete_blocked: This book has been borrowed: its history is kept and it can no longer be deleted. Withdraw its copies from the collection instead.
book.enriched: Record found — the empty fields have been filled in.
book.out_share_help: Share of the time a copy has spent out, since it entered the catalogue.
book.loan_closed: The current loan has been closed: the copy is declared lost or withdrawn, and will no longer appear among the overdue books.
book.not_found: No record found in the catalogues (BnF, UniCat, Google Books, Open Library) — the fields are left to fill in by hand.
book.catalogues_silent: The catalogues did not answer — nothing could be learnt about this book. Try again in a minute, or fill the fields in by hand.
borrower.book_days_help: One book kept for one day counts as one book-day. Totalled over the last 12 months.
borrower.none_current: No book borrowed at the moment.
borrowers.confirm_create:
Please confirm creating a *loans link*.
A secret link to the books out and when they are due, to give to the borrower or to their relatives. Nothing is sent: you share it however you like, and it can be revoked.
borrowers.confirm_deactivate: Please confirm deactivating *{0} {1}*. The borrower will no longer appear in the list (reversible from “See the inactive ones”).
borrowers.confirm_regenerate: Please confirm regenerating the link. The old link, which may already have been given out, *will stop working*.
borrowers.confirm_revoke: Please confirm revoking the link. *The old link will stop working.*
borrowers.empty: No borrowers. Add one, import a CSV, or widen the search.
borrowers.err_name_required: First name and last name are required.
borrowers.err_reactivate_anonymised: This record has been anonymised: the first name, the group and the card have been erased, so there is no one left to reactivate. If the reader comes back, add them again.
borrowers.err_reactivate_sentinel: “{0}” is not a person: this record holds the anonymised loans and cannot be reactivated.
borrowers.err_still_has_books.one: {1} {2} still has {0} book out — return it first, or declare it lost from the book page.
borrowers.err_still_has_books.other: {1} {2} still has {0} books out — return them first, or declare them lost from the book page.
borrowers.inactive_note: These borrowers are no longer offered for lending, but their history is kept. “Reactivate” puts them back in the list.
borrowers.privacy_note: Data protection: only the initial of the last name is kept (“Durant” → “D.”).
borrowers.rollover_action: Move on to the next year

catalogue.batch_help: Scan the books one after the other. What is about to be added appears on the right: change the number of copies or remove a book, then add them all at once. Scanning a book again adds a copy. Batch mode works from the ISBN: a book without one, or that no catalogue knows, is added one book at a time.

catalogue.batch_location_help: The location is applied to every book added.
catalogue.batch_refused_help: These books cannot be added in a batch. Add them one by one; the batch under way stays here.
catalogue.batch_single: Back to one book at a time

catalogue.err_catalogues_silent: Some catalogues did not answer — the book may well exist: type it in by hand, or try again in a minute.
catalogue.f_authors_placeholder: Last name, First name; Last name, First name
catalogue.google_tip: Tip: some books (recent ones, common editions) are only found by Google Books, which is currently limited. If many books stay unfound, a Google Books key can be added in Settings.
catalogue.label_needed: This book has no ISBN: stick a label on it so it can be scanned when lent and returned.
catalogue.no_label_needed: Lending is done by scanning the ISBN on the back of the book — no need to stick a label on.
catalogue.no_record: No record found automatically — fill it in by hand. The ISBN is kept.

catalogue.sse_no_answer: {0} did not answer — the book may be there all the same.

import.columns_rules: Separator “,”, “;” or tab (copied from a spreadsheet). A header line is ignored. Only the initial of the last name is kept.
import.duplicates.one: {0} line matches a borrower already on file (same first name, same initial, same group): it will be ignored. Re-importing the updated list is therefore safe.
import.duplicates.other: {0} lines match a borrower already on file (same first name, same initial, same group): they will be ignored. Re-importing the updated list is therefore safe.
import.err_all_known: All these borrowers are already on file — nothing to import.
import.err_no_usable_line: No usable line. Expected format: first name, last name, group.
import.err_workbook: This file is an Excel workbook, which the import cannot read. Open it, select the cells, copy them and paste them into the text box.
import.force_duplicates.one: Also import the duplicate — only if they really are namesakes
import.force_duplicates.other: Also import the {0} duplicates — only if they really are namesakes
import.skipped.one: {0} line skipped: it lacks the first name or the last name. Check that each column is in its place.
import.skipped.other: {0} lines skipped: they lack the first name or the last name. Check that each column is in its place.
import.template_hint: Fill it in, then select the cells (the header row may be included), copy them and paste them into the box below.

rollover.confirm:
Please confirm the year rollover.
Readers change group and leavers are deactivated. Read the table again: *there is no one-click undo*.
rollover.err_changed: The groups have changed since this page was opened: the year rollover may already have been applied. Nothing was changed. Check the table below before applying it.
rollover.help_3: to deactivate the readers who are leaving.
rollover.help_prefilled: When a group name contains a number, the new group is filled in one year up (P3 → P4). The last year of each cycle (P6, K3…) and groups without a number are left empty for you to decide.
rollover.kept_active: Kept active — they still have books to return:
rollover.merge_entry.one: {1} keeps {0} reader who is neither moving up nor leaving, and would receive {2}.
rollover.merge_entry.other: {1} keeps {0} readers who are neither moving up nor leaving, and would receive {2}.
rollover.merge_fix: Nothing has been changed. In the same submission, give that group a new group or tick it as leaving. If the merge is intended, apply anyway.
rollover.merge_intro: This rollover would mix two groups of readers in one group, and nothing could tell them apart afterwards:
settings.access_hint: Valid while Bibli runs at this address. Reserve a fixed IP for the machine so it does not change.
settings.access_intro: The address to give users so they can connect from their own device on the local network:
settings.access_loopback: Bibli is open locally (localhost): this address only works on this machine. To share it, open Bibli by the computer's network address (e.g. http://192.168.1.42:8080), then come back here.
settings.backup_download_note: The file holds the whole collection and every borrower: keep it as you would keep the library register.
settings.backup_failed_help: Check that the folder exists and is writable.
settings.backup_keep_note: Kept: the last 7 days, the last 4 weeks and the last 4 months. Remember to copy one off site.
settings.backup_never: None since startup — Bibli checks a minute after launch, then every hour, and backs up when today's copy is missing.
settings.cache_note: ({0}), read back from disk without calling the catalogues again. “Enrich from the ISBN”, on a book page, asks for its own again.
settings.cache_off_suffix: : every display queries the catalogues again.
settings.covers_absent_note: no catalogue had one on the day they were asked about, and they are not asked again.
settings.covers_forget_confirm:
Please confirm forgetting the *{0}* recorded absences.
The catalogues will be asked again as each book's page is opened. The covers already kept are left alone.
settings.covers_forgotten.one: {0} absence forgotten: the catalogue will be asked again next time that book is opened.
settings.covers_forgotten.other: {0} absences forgotten: the catalogues will be asked again as the books are opened.
settings.err_loan_days: The loan period must be a number of days between 1 and 365.
settings.err_retention: The retention period must be a number of years between 1 and {0}.
settings.err_google_key: The Google Books key cannot contain spaces or line breaks.
settings.express_catalogue_help: When a book absent from the catalogue is scanned at the desk, Bibli offers to create it on the spot, prefilled from the online catalogues, and to lend it in the same gesture. Clear this if acquisitions must go through “Catalogue”: the desk will then say the book has to be catalogued first.
settings.express_catalogue_label: Allow adding an unknown book during a loan
settings.tracking_links_help: Each borrower can get a secret link to the books they have out, to give to their relatives. Cleared, the “Loans link” column disappears and links already given stop working; they come back if you tick it again.
settings.tracking_links_label: Offer a loans link per borrower
settings.tracking_links_single: Unavailable in the Mac or Windows app: Bibli can only be reached from this computer, so no one else could open the link.
settings.google_key_env_help: The server's BIBLI_GOOGLE_BOOKS_KEY variable provides the key and overrides this field: it is changed in the server configuration.
settings.google_key_help: Optional. Without a key, Google Books answers on a shared anonymous quota and often refuses: some books stay unfound. A free key is created in the Google Cloud console, by enabling the Books API there. Once saved it is never shown again — typing another replaces it — and it is kept in the database, and so in the backups.
settings.language_help: Language of the interface, printouts and exports. It applies to the whole library.
settings.retention_help: After {0} years, a returned book stops being tied to the person who borrowed it, and a reader who has left loses first name, group, card and loans link. Nothing is deleted: the book keeps its loan count, and as long as the period has not elapsed everything is reversible.
settings.theme_help: The colours of the screens, for the whole library. Printouts stay black and white.
settings.year_start: Start of the year in the statistics
settings.year_start_help: The first day of this month opens a new year: the grid on the home screen and the list of most borrowed books start again from zero. September for a school year, January for a calendar year.
stats.idle_none: Every work has gone out at least once.
stats.idle_summary.one: {0} work out of {1} has never gone out ({2} %)
stats.idle_summary.other: {0} works out of {1} have never gone out ({2} %)
stats.review_help.one: One row per title, in shelf-mark order: copies and their codes, condition, loans, days out, first and last loan, share of time on the shelf. Enough to decide, once a year, what moves, what is replaced and what is withdrawn. The file names no one, and the number of different borrowers only reaches back {0} year: past that, loans are anonymised.
stats.review_help.other: One row per title, in shelf-mark order: copies and their codes, condition, loans, days out, first and last loan, share of time on the shelf. Enough to decide, once a year, what moves, what is replaced and what is withdrawn. The file names no one, and the number of different borrowers only reaches back {0} years: past that, loans are anonymised.
